scope: Engineering estimate with named exclusions, NOT a complete supply total, measured hardware demand, a guaranteed maximum, or achieved tracking
source_boundary: 12 V stiff DC link, explicit regeneration sink accepted; no upstream or capacitor transient model

omitted_losses: Winding proximity and via-specific AC loss not represented by isolated slab approximation
Inductor AC loss outside 100 kHz fundamental and bias/temperature effects not characterized
Board-level controller/regulator and source wiring consumption not specified
fader-full-forward.model_reference: Explicit engineering estimate, not a measured or complete hardware total: TI DRV8311 SLVSFN2B sections 7.5/12.3.1, 25 °C driver, assumed SLEW=01, DEADTIME=001, 0.7 V diode drop and sinusoidal cycle-average mapping; Bourns SRP1265WA-470M 47 µH Q=20 at 100 kHz/1 V and 74.1 mΩ typical DCR at 25 °C; inductor temperature assumed equal to winding. Q excess is combined AC-loss proxy, not isolated core loss. Isolated copper slab uses full-network DC resistance as proxy; proximity and via AC distribution omitted. 12 V stiff DC-link boundary excludes upstream wiring and board-level loads. Not a guaranteed bound or hardware qualification. Sources: https://www.ti.com/document-viewer/DRV8311/datasheet/GUID-C826F7E8-19E5-47C8-9C09-E13912428538 and https://www.bourns.com/docs/product-datasheets/srp1265wa.pdf
fader-full-forward.ripple_reference: 50%-duty two-phase RL p-p used as triangular phase-pair mixture; Lphase=0.00004982583612235492 H, Rphase=5.071886042401691 Ω, pp=0.29471399821317074 A. Approximate, not actual PWM or universal bound.
